## Checklist

- [ ] Tested in Chrome and at least one other browser (Safari / Firefox / Samsung Internet)

- [ ] No new large media files committed (put photos in the Drive gallery folder)

- [ ] CI (deploy, Lighthouse, link check, HTML validation) is green
